title: We’re prototyping a text based AI game (W) and looking for feedback..
author: sanjusan39
selftext:
hey everyone 👋

we’ve been prototyping a game where ai agents with unique personalities and strategies compete against each other, and we’re looking for feedback on the core gameplay.

the idea is that you create an agent, talk to it, it "learns" from you, and then competes with other players’ agents in a strategy-based game. each agent starts with 5 $W (#ingame currency who's utility we're yet to hone in on) and the goal is to end with the highest balance. agents also have memory and can adapt to other agents’ behaviors over multiple games.

we’re building this on langchain, vertex, and bedrock, and are just trying to figure out if the game mechanics are actually fun or engaging. if you’re interested, you can check it out at [enterw.xyz](https://enterw.xyz/).

any feedback would mean a lot — thanks for reading!

comments.author: cdcox
comments.body:
Played half a round my thoughts:

Decent idea for a game multi agent market stuff is cool. And being able to define the agent is really fun.

Things I struggled with:

I don't really know crypto at all so how the markets are working is very opaque to me. Like what is minting etc.

I don't know what level of model this is. My agent and strategy would change a lot knowing it's a 1b vs a gpt4 level. Giving a hint to that at the intro would be nice.

There isn't enough feedback as to what is happening. The game is too "quiet" there should be pop up pings when sales happen. I think it should be almost over the top. Right now I get bored very quickly. Needs more light and color maybe sound. Markets are fundamentally boring which is why people spice them up.

Also the whole game is a little slow. I watched for 2 minutes and a couple convos happened and it wasn't clear if my AI made good or bad trades. It would be nice to see if my trades were net valuable or losses. Also it's not clear the point of trading, can the coin not go back to cash for some reason? Maybe if my net value of position was reported.

I'd also consider allowing a tutorial mode where a human can play against agents it might let people get a feel for what is actually going on.

It's also not clear if my bot only sees current price or history or the curves I see. Letting me know it's information state would be useful.

The chats are fun and amusing seems like usual 3.5/4o-mini silliness. I'd ping if we get a message.

I think there's a lot of good ideas here. I just think the feel of the game isn't quite there and a lot of the ideas of crypto are kind of unclear to anyone who isn't super in the area. Also too slow since the player can't do anything but watch.

replies.author: sanjusan39
replies.body:
thank you so much for testing it and leaving such a treasure trove of feedback!

we definitely tunnel-visioned ourselves into adding crypto terms that don’t make immediate sense to most folks, so improving clarity around that makes total sense. the same goes for all your suggestions about making the gameplay more engaging thru visuals and sound effects — your ideas would really help elevate the experience.

as for the pacing and balance, i couldn’t agree more—it’s something we’re actively tweaking, and hearing your perspective on it is incredibly helpful. we've also been tinkering with the idea of adding a narrator to summarize the gameplay as it unfolds, similar to commentators during a live game.. it'd keep the player up to date, help them figure out what other agents are up to etc..basically ensuring the human player stays at the center of the action is key.

the human-vs-agents play mode is such an intriguing idea, too. we leaned towards agent-to-agent trades because those transactions are happening at API call speeds, which might be too fast for a human player to keep up with. but introducing a player-vs-agent mode, especially as a tutorial like you mentioned, could actually be beneficial for the player —  def something worth exploring..

once again, thank you for sharing sooo much great feedback here; im very excited to take this back to the team and push a bunch of your recommendations into the next iteration!

replies.author: cdcox
replies.body: Look forward to seeing what the next round looks like!  Yea API speed stuff makes sense.

replies.author: thoughtlow
replies.body: Do you think you will keep claude-3-5-sonnet as main llm? Will it be viable when you are going to scale this up?

comments.author: thoughtlow
comments.body: Game feels a little slow, the convos between the bots, if you read them once you read them all kinda feeling. Maybe more visual indicators if you are doing good or bad, it needs to feel rewarding if you are doing good, so show it visually. Maybe arrows next to the 4 boths who has gone up or down since last round. Give the no.1 a crown idk.
